subject.title: feat(skills): background lifecycle curator for workshop-created skills

question: Should existing workshop-created skills with no historical usage rows be eligible for automatic archive on the first upgrade sweep, or should legacy records get an observation/migration path before archival?
rationale: The patch's fixed 30/90-day policy is a product default that can change existing users' future skill snapshots, and the repository policy treats stored state and default behavior changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve legacy skills first
options.body: Keep pre-curator skills active or pinned until new post-upgrade usage data, an explicit migration, or a visible operator action makes archival safe.

options.title: Accept immediate curation
options.body: Allow first-sweep archival based on old appliedAt timestamps, but document the upgrade behavior and restore command clearly before merge.

options.title: Pause lifecycle in core
options.body: Defer this PR until the broader lifecycle direction in the linked feature request is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy skills first
recommendation.body: Keep pre-curator skills active or pinned until new post-upgrade usage data, an explicit migration, or a visible operator action makes archival safe.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is maintainer-labeled and steipete is both the PR author and the strongest recent routing signal for this cross-cutting product/protocol change.
